name: Hexagon Rotate
description: A regular hexagon spins continuously for a clean geometric loading animation

variations.name: default
variations.description: A hexagon outline or filled shape rotates 360° continuously with smooth linear motion

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: thickness
props.description: Stroke width when not filled, in pixels

props.name: filled
props.description: Whether to render the hexagon as filled or outline only

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
